ARCANA.name: The Fool
ARCANA.does: Choose any Major Arcana: it is that one.

ARCANA.name: The Magician
ARCANA.does: +2 for each Ace in your winning hand.

ARCANA.name: The High Priestess
ARCANA.does: Nothing can reveal your hand.

ARCANA.name: The Empress
ARCANA.does: +2 for each Queen in your winning hand.

ARCANA.name: The Emperor
ARCANA.does: +2 for each King in your winning hand.

ARCANA.name: The Hierophant
ARCANA.does: Name a rank: +1 for each card of it in your winning hand.

ARCANA.name: The Lovers
ARCANA.does: Link with a player: neither steals from the other, and your arcana count for both.

ARCANA.name: The Chariot
ARCANA.does: +2 for each Knight in your winning hand.

ARCANA.name: Strength
ARCANA.does: x2, and +1 for each other Strength on the table.

ARCANA.name: The Hermit
ARCANA.does: Look at your next nine cards; put any on top, the rest beneath.

ARCANA.name: The Wheel of Fortune
ARCANA.does: Throw back up to eight cards and draw as many.

ARCANA.name: Justice
ARCANA.does: Every stolen card goes home; its owner takes it back as if drawn.

ARCANA.name: The Hanged Man
ARCANA.does: Your discards become your draw pile, and your draw pile your discards.

ARCANA.name: Death
ARCANA.does: The round starts again; next round everyone begins with two arcana.

ARCANA.name: Temperance
ARCANA.does: +1 for each steal no one used this round.

ARCANA.name: The Devil
ARCANA.does: +1 for each steal made this round, and one more steal for you.

ARCANA.name: The Tower
ARCANA.does: Your hand goes back into your deck; draw eight new. +4 if you win this round.

ARCANA.name: The Star
ARCANA.does: Your discards shuffle back into your deck.

ARCANA.name: The Moon
ARCANA.does: Your discards are face down from now on.

ARCANA.name: The Sun
ARCANA.does: Choose a player: their hand is shown to you.

ARCANA.name: Judgement
ARCANA.does: Choose a player: they cannot steal; +2 for each card they stole.

ARCANA.name: The World
ARCANA.does: +1 for each different arcana on the table.
